overview: This paper proposes DualDiff, a unified latent diffusion model with a two-branch diffusion process and a dual conditioning mechanism to jointly learn local and global topological information for effective and efficient graph generation.

modules.name: Data Loading and Preprocessing
modules.description: Loads generic and molecular graph datasets, parses node features, adjacency matrices, and 3D coordinates, and prepares data structures for downstream graph neural networks.

modules.name: Global Information Extraction
modules.description: Implements graph clustering algorithms (spectral clustering for generic graphs, coordinate-based K-means for molecular graphs) and pooling operations to extract topologically-enhanced global cluster-level embeddings from node-level representations.

modules.name: Graph Autoencoder Architecture
modules.description: Constructs the autoencoder consisting of an equivariant graph neural network (EGNN) or standard GNN encoder, and a decoder that integrates global and local information via FiLM layers to reconstruct node features and adjacency matrices.

modules.name: Autoencoder Pretraining Pipeline
modules.description: Manages the first-stage training of the graph autoencoder, optimizing the reconstruction loss to learn a meaningful and compact latent space mapping for graphs.

modules.name: Two-Branch Diffusion Forward Process
modules.description: Implements the forward stochastic differential equations (SDEs) for both the local node-level and global cluster-level branches in the latent space, following the EDM noise scheduling framework.

modules.name: Dual Conditioning Mechanism
modules.description: Implements the core innovation, including the Global-to-Local process (using predicted global representations to generate FiLM parameters for local denoising) and the Local-to-Global process (pooling predicted local details to condition global denoising), with probabilistic sampling between the two processes.

modules.name: Denoising Network Architectures
modules.description: Implements the denoising networks for local and global branches, utilizing equivariant graph neural networks for molecular tasks and graph transformers for generic graph tasks, integrated with the dual conditioning inputs.

modules.name: Diffusion Model Training Pipeline
modules.description: Handles the second-stage training of the two-branch latent diffusion model, computing the denoising loss with dual conditioning, and optimizing the denoising networks while keeping the autoencoder frozen.

modules.name: Diffusion Model Sampling Pipeline
modules.description: Implements the reverse sampling process with the asymmetric alternating strategy (multiple local update steps followed by a global aggregation step), using numerical ODE solvers, and decoding the final latent representations back to the graph space.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Calculation
modules.description: Computes generation quality metrics including MMD-based statistics (degree, clustering, orbit, spectral) for generic graphs, and FCD, KL divergence, validity, uniqueness, and novelty for molecular graphs, as well as atom/molecule stability for 3D generation.

modules.name: Ablation and Sensitivity Analysis Framework
modules.description: Provides configurations and execution scripts for ablation studies on the conditioning mechanisms (none, self, unidirectional, bidirectional), clustering methods, and hyperparameter sensitivity analysis.

modules.name: Conditional Generation Module
modules.description: Extends the framework for property-conditioned molecular generation by integrating a property encoder, modifying the diffusion process with conditional embeddings, and evaluating the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) between target and predicted properties.

modules.name: Experiment Management and Utilities
modules.description: Manages experimental configurations, logging, checkpoint saving/loading, distributed training setup, and automated generation of result tables and visualizations.
